appStore:
Find comic reading lists and keep track of what you've read. Recap Page shows the next unread comic in every list, so you can always pick up where you left off.

Read your way:

- New to Marvel comics? Open the guide from Home for a quick introduction, starter picks and two optional reading lists you can preview before saving.

- Explore a modern timeline, eras, genres, character spotlights, lists for younger readers, creator guides and movie prep guides. Follow Reading Paths along the timeline.

- Take a break: Defer for later skips a comic in one list without marking it read. Return to deferred or earlier comics anytime.

- Make your own lists: search comics, series and creators, add comics by hand and write notes.

- Back up or share: back up automatically to your own iCloud Drive or OneDrive, one at a time, save a backup of your reading data, or share a reading order as a checklist without your notes, reading history or availability choices. With OneDrive, Recap Page can offer progress from your other devices when it differs, and you choose which to use.

- Made for touch: larger buttons, light and dark themes, compact filters and easy-to-reach list options. Text follows your system text size, and the layout adapts to iPad windows.

A comic marked read stays read across lists, and each list keeps its own order.

Your lists, progress and notes stay on your device. Recap Page uploads your saved data only if you turn on cloud backup, and then only to your own iCloud or OneDrive. There is no Recap Page account to create, and no ads or tracking.

Reading lists credit Comic Book Herald and Comic Book Reading Orders where their guides supply the comics and order. Some Marvel Comics links come from Comic Book Reading Orders.

When a comic has a Marvel Comics link, Read opens that link. Until reading in Marvel Unlimited ends on December 7, 2026, some comics can also be opened there. Starting December 7, Read opens the general Marvel Comics website for a comic without a Marvel Comics link. Comics are not included. Marvel decides what is available to read and whether an account or payment is needed.

Recap Page is an unofficial fan companion. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Marvel Entertainment or Disney. Marvel names and marks belong to their respective owners.

Follow Marvel stories across series and pick up at your next unread comic. Recap Page gives you reading lists for events, eras and characters, with progress, notes and ratings saved on your device.

Mark comics read as you go, or mark a whole list read at once. Save everything to a backup file, or turn on automatic backup to your own OneDrive. OneDrive is optional and off until you choose it. Microsoft can read your backups, your account protects them, and the developer never receives them.

When a comic has a Marvel Comics link, Read opens that link. Until reading in Marvel Unlimited ends on December 7, 2026, some comics can also be opened there. Starting December 7, Read opens the general Marvel Comics website for a comic without a Marvel Comics link. Comics are not included. Marvel decides what is available to read and whether an account or payment is needed. Pasted Marvel Unlimited reader links are no longer accepted.

You do not need a Recap Page account. There are no ads or tracking. Covers and comic details come from Marvel and a comics information website.
